description: 3DBAG is an open dataset of 3D building models for the whole of the Netherlands, generated fully automatically at three levels of detail (LoD1.2, LoD1.3 and LoD2.2), with 2D projections of roof surfaces and their heights. It is produced by the 3D geoinformation research group at TU Delft and the company 3DGI by combining the national building register BAG with the AHN national elevation point cloud, using only open-source software such as the roofer reconstruction tool. Coverage is every building in the national register; underground and overlapping parts are removed and glass-roofed buildings such as greenhouses fall back to simple models. The release of 9 September 2025 added 3D Tiles and IFC outputs and a ridgeline height attribute. Access: a web viewer with tile downloads in CityJSON, GeoPackage, FlatGeobuf, OBJ and IFC, and web services. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, credit '3DBAG by tudelft3d and 3DGI'; free. Caveats: model quality follows the age and density of the AHN point cloud and the BAG outlines, which include underground parts. Simulation uses are city and national digital twins, flood and heat exposure with building heights, and solar and energy analyses. Related records: BAG (Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen), its building source, and AHN, its height source.
